title: 第26章 大伯的肯定
novel_title: 1960：九个妹妹把我宠上天(天下第九)
content_zh: 嫂子们带着小孩回家。老宅里顿时安静了不少。爷奶与几个堂哥一桌吃肉喝酒，他们也喊辰楠去参加，但辰楠并没有参与。他有些时间没回来了，他要和小孩一桌，跟侄儿妹妹们热闹热闹。他看向乖巧坐在一桌的妹妹们。九个妹妹就凑成了一个小桌子。“你们都吃饱了吗？”辰楠看着妹妹们轻声开口，生怕她们怕不够吃而少吃。“吃饱了哥哥。”“我都吃撑了。”“好饱啊！”招娣、来娣、盼娣等妹妹们都一脸满足地回答。就连最小的幺妹也摸着鼓鼓的肚子，说自已好久没吃过这样好吃的东西，真的好饱饱，是不是以后都可以这样？辰楠的回答是肯定的，有他在不用再饿肚子，以后她们都可以吃饱饭。妹妹们听到这话欢呼雀跃起来。辰楠笑容满面，看着妹妹们如此开心，他内心也觉得很满足。妹妹们在院子里玩耍，与旁边推杯换盏的酒桌形成了一幅充满人间烟火气息的画卷。辰楠陪妹妹们玩了会，就被堂哥辰建设喊喝酒。“你们先喝，我拿点好东西给你们。”说着他就回里屋翻找行李，见没人他从空间里拿出一个早已准备好的麻包袋。就在这时。院子的门被敲响。喝酒的人立即安静了下来。他们现在还在喝酒吃肉，若是有村里人来了可不好。要是被村里人看到，估计得举报他们侵占集体财产。山上的一切都是集体的，即便是捡到的野猪也是集体的，要上交！谁敢私自留下集体财产，被发现是要挨批斗的。这时，一个声音从外面传了进来。“听说小楠回来了，我过来看看。”这是大伯的声音，招娣小跑去开门。只见一个五十多岁的黝黑老汉站在门外。那双充满智慧的眼神瞟向院内，一双鼻子不自觉耸动着。“大伯，你怎么才来？”招娣把大伯迎进来后立即关上了门。“招娣啊，大伯这可是家都还未进就赶过来的。”“刚回来就听说小楠回来了，我这激动啊！”辰东北爽朗一笑，抬腿就走进院子，看到院子里喝酒的人，他径直走过去，“老爹您少喝点，我还没吃饭，给我留点。”刚回到家的时候他可是听说辰楠捡了一只野猪，一次性就炖了大半头猪，晚餐他们都吃得饱饱的。甚至还带了四分之一头野猪肉回来！儿媳与小孩在家，但儿子还在老爹家，这不，他立即就赶了过来。“爹你终于回来了。”辰建设主动让开位置让老爹坐下，而他重新搬来凳子。爷爷则是瞪了辰东北一眼：“混小子，再迟点回来就没你的份了。”奶奶接过话茬：“别听你爹瞎说，给你留着呢。”这时，招娣从灶台里端出一小盆肉。“大伯，你的肉来啦。”辰东北看到一盆肉，哈喇子都快流下来了，“哈哈哈，还是招娣乖，真没白疼你。”桌子上的肉被吃得七七八八，如今新端上来的肉还冒着热气，香气四溢，闻之食欲大增。辰建设给老爹让座，辰建国给老爹倒酒，辰建军给老爹夹菜，辰建民给老爹倒酒。看到四个儿子如此懂事会做，辰东北咧嘴一笑，随手就夹了一块肥瘦相间的猪肉给他老爹，“爹您吃。”随即他才把碗里的肉放进嘴里。“香，真香！”辰东北眯着眼，一脸迷醉的样子。他上次吃肉的时候……多久了？似乎是三个月前，而且只是吃了一小块而已。这时辰楠从里屋出来，手里提着那个鼓鼓囊囊的麻包袋。他一眼就看见酒桌上多了一个人，刚才在里屋他就听到了一些声音。那人约莫五十多岁，皮肤黝黑，穿着一件洗得发白的蓝色工装。虽然坐着也能看出个子不高，但一双眼睛格外有神，正灵活地打量着院子里的情况。这正是他的大伯辰东北，胜利大队的大队长。“大伯——你回来了。”辰楠笑着打招呼。辰东北闻声转过头来，黝黑的脸上顿时绽开笑容。“小楠！几个月不见，又长高了不少！”他听到声音，扭过头看向辰楠，声音洪亮，“大伯今天可是沾了你的光。”“要不是你打了这头野猪，咱们哪能吃上这么丰盛的肉啊！小楠啊，你还真是咱们家的福星，一回来就有肉吃！”辰楠笑着说：“大伯你来得正好，我带了点好东西回来孝敬你们。”他朝着酒桌走了一半，看见妹妹们还在院子里玩耍，便朝她们招招手：“大妹，二妹，时间不早了，你们先带妹妹们去洗澡。”招娣乖巧地应了一声：“好。”便要领着妹妹们往厨房去。“等等，”辰楠又叫住她们，语气温和却坚定，“把新衣服和新鞋子都换上。”这话像一颗石子投入平静的湖面，顿时在妹妹们中间激起阵阵涟漪。“真的可以穿新衣服吗？”二妹来娣不敢相信地睁大眼睛。“我们不是说留着过年穿吗？”“现在真的可以穿新衣服吗？”妹妹们瞪大双眼，穿新衣服耶，真的可以吗？招娣作为大姐，虽然也很想立刻穿上那身漂亮的粉红色新衣，但还是懂事地说：“哥，要不还是留着过年吧？这么新的衣服......”“穿！”辰楠斩钉截铁地说，“哥哥说了，以后还会给你们买新衣服。大家都穿上新衣服，让大伯也看看咱们家的小姑娘们有多漂亮！”妹妹们顿时欢呼雀跃，叽叽喳喳地讨论起来。“我要穿那件蓝色的！”“我的发卡是红色的蝴蝶！”“新鞋子！我要穿新鞋子！”九个妹妹像一群快乐的小麻雀，簇拥着朝厨房方向跑去。她们要去烧水洗澡，想要快点穿新衣服。院子里顿时安静了不少，只剩下酒桌上的一群人，喝了点酒的就在吹牛皮。辰楠提起麻包袋，走到酒桌前坐下。大伯正在给爷爷倒酒夹菜，还真是个孝顺的儿子。酒香以及野猪肉的香味环绕在酒桌上经久不散。“这野猪可真不小，“辰东北抿了一口酒，满足地咂咂嘴，“小楠，大伯从小就看好你。”这是来自大伯的肯定。“果然啊，这次你回来竟然带了一头野猪回来，快跟大伯说说，你是怎么逮着这大家伙的？”他来得匆忙，并不知道这野猪是怎么来的。只知道辰楠回来了，还带了头野猪回来。
content_en: The sisters-in-law came home with their children.The old house suddenly became quieter.Grandma and several cousins ​​ate meat and drank wine at the same table. They also called Chen Nan to participate, but Chen Nan did not participate.He hasn't been back for some time. He wants to sit at the table with the children and lively with his nephews and sisters.He looked at his sisters sitting obediently at the same table.The nine sisters gathered together to form a small table."Are you all full?" Chen Nan looked at the sisters and spoke softly, fearing that they would eat less because they were afraid of not having enough to eat."I'm full, brother." "I'm full." "So full!" Zhaodi, Laidi, Pandi and other sisters all answered with satisfaction.Even the youngest Yaomei touched her bulging belly and said that she hadn't eaten such delicious food in a long time. She felt really full. Can she always feel like this?Chen Nan's answer was yes. With him here, they no longer need to go hungry, and they would all be able to have enough to eat in the future.The sisters cheered when they heard this.Chen Nan smiled broadly. Seeing his sisters so happy, he felt very satisfied inside.The sisters were playing in the yard, and the wine table beside them formed a picture full of human fireworks.After Chen Nan played with her sisters for a while, her cousin Chen Jianshe asked her to drink."You drink first, I'll get you something good." After saying that, he went back to the back room to look for his luggage. When he saw no one was there, he took out a sack bag that had been prepared for him.Just then.There was a knock on the courtyard door.The drinkers immediately fell silent.They are still drinking and eating meat. It would not be good if people from the village come.If they were seen by the villagers, they would probably be reported for usurping collective property.Everything on the mountain is collective, even the wild boars picked up are collective and must be handed over!Anyone who dares to leave collective property privately will be criticized and beaten if found out.At this time, a voice came in from outside."I heard that Xiao Nan is back. I came to take a look." This was the uncle's voice, and Zhao Di trotted to open the door.I saw a dark old man in his fifties standing outside the door.Those eyes full of wisdom glanced into the courtyard, and their noses twitched unconsciously."Uncle, why are you here?" Zhao Di welcomed the uncle in and immediately closed the door."Zhao Di, my uncle came over here before everyone came home." "I just came back and heard that Xiao Nan was back. I'm so excited!" Chen Dongbei smiled heartily and walked into the yard. When he saw the people drinking in the yard, he walked straight over and said, "Dad, please drink less. I haven't eaten yet, so leave some for me." When he first got home, he heard that Chen Nan had picked up a wild boar and stewed half of the pig in one go. They were all full for dinner.We even brought back a quarter of a wild boar!The daughter-in-law and the child were at home, but the son was still at his father's house. No, he rushed over immediately."Dad, you are finally back." Chen Jianshe took the initiative to make way for his father to sit down, and he moved the stool again.Grandpa glared at Chen Dongbei: "You bastard, if you come back later, it won't be your fault." Grandma took over the words: "Don't listen to your father's nonsense, I'll keep it for you." At this time, Zhao Di took out a small pot of meat from the stove."Uncle, your meat is here." Chen Dongbei saw a pot of meat and his mouth was almost watering. "Hahaha, I'm still a good Zhaodi. I really don't hurt you in vain." The meat on the table has been eaten to pieces, and now the newly served meat is still steaming and fragrant, and the smell of it greatly increases the appetite.Chen Jianshe gave up his seat to his father, Chen Jianguo poured wine for his father, Chen Jianjun served his father some food, and Chen Jianmin poured wine for his father.Seeing that his four sons were so sensible and well-behaved, Chen Dongbei grinned and handed a piece of fat and thin pork to his father. "Father, eat it." Then he put the meat in the bowl into his mouth."Smells, it smells so good!" Chen Dongbei squinted his eyes, looking intoxicated.How long had it been since he last ate meat?It seems to have been three months ago, and it was just a small piece.At this time, Nan came out of the back room, holding the bulging sack in his hand.He saw an extra person at the wine table at a glance, and he heard some noises in the back room just now.The man was about fifty years old, with dark skin and wearing a blue work clothes that had been washed white.Although he was not very tall, it could be seen from sitting down, but his eyes were particularly alert and he was flexibly looking at the situation in the yard.This is his eldest brother Dongbei, the captain of the Victory Brigade."Uncle - you're back." Chen Nan greeted with a smile.Chen Dongbei turned his head when he heard the sound, and a smile suddenly broke out on his dark face."Xiao Nan! I haven't seen you for a few months, and you have grown a lot!" Hearing the voice, he turned to look at Chen Nan with a loud voice, "Uncle, I have benefited from you today." "If you hadn't killed this wild boar, how could we have eaten such a rich meat! Xiao Nan, you are really our family's lucky star, we will have meat to eat as soon as you come back!" Chen Nan said with a smile: "Uncle, you came just in time. I brought some good things back to honor you." He walked halfway towards the wine table and saw his sisters still playing in the yard, so he waved to them: "Eldest sister, second sister, it's getting late, you take the sisters to take a bath first." Zhaodi responded obediently: "Okay." Then she led the sisters to the kitchen."Wait," Chen Nan called them again, with a gentle but firm tone, "Put on new clothes and new shoes." These words were like a pebble thrown into a calm lake, immediately causing ripples among the sisters."Can I really wear new clothes?" Second sister Laidi opened her eyes in disbelief."Didn't we say we would save it for the New Year?" "Can I really wear new clothes now?" The sisters widened their eyes and asked, "Is it really okay to wear new clothes?"As the eldest sister, Zhaodi wanted to put on the beautiful new pink clothes immediately, but she still said sensibly: "Brother, why don't you keep it for the New Year? Such new clothes..." "Wear!" Chen Nan said decisively, "Brother said that I will buy you new clothes in the future. Everyone wear new clothes, let uncle see how beautiful the little girls in our family are!" The sisters immediately cheered and started chattering."I want to wear that blue one!" "My hairpin is a red butterfly!" "New shoes! I want to wear new shoes!" The nine sisters were like a group of happy little sparrows, running toward the kitchen.They had to boil water to take a bath and wear new clothes quickly.The courtyard suddenly became quite quiet, with only a group of people at the wine table remaining. Those who had drunk some wine were bragging.Chen Nan picked up the sack and walked to the wine table to sit down.The uncle is pouring wine and vegetables for grandpa. He is really a filial son.The aroma of wine and wild boar lingers around the wine table for a long time."This wild boar is really quite big," Chen Dongbei took a sip of wine and smacked his lips with satisfaction, "Xiao Nan, uncle has been optimistic about you since you were a child." This was the affirmation from the uncle."Sure enough, you brought back a wild boar this time. Tell me, how did you catch this big guy?" He came in a hurry and didn't know where the wild boar came from.All I knew was that Chen Nan was back and brought a wild boar with him.
